replay_comparison: exact decoded text, termination, and scoring; token equality reported separately
evaluation_budget_scope: per checkpoint: legacy evaluation plus all primary/replay launch wall time; interrupted launches reserve their entire allowance
preparation_budget_scope: Verify already cached baseline files within 600 seconds; no downloads.
memory_enforcement: systemd cgroup MemoryMax at max_rss_bytes, MemorySwapMax=0; recorded peak RSS must also pass because shared pages can be charged elsewhere
timeout_enforcement: systemd RuntimeMaxSec and TimeoutStopSec=0; min(task limit, remaining checkpoint budget)
legacy_evidence: Closed diagnostic comparator and cost record only; no legacy answer is reused as a new reply.
stop_rule: Only these three opened cases, once, with one fixed corrected prompt. Replay successful calls; stop on execution or replay failure. Zero correct calls is a negative diagnostic. No automatic new prompt, backbone, training, or larger-model launch.
worker_environment: existing evolution package startup profile: ATen default, MKL SSE4.2, one Torch/OMP/MKL thread; CPU only; OpenBLAS also limited to one thread
replay_policy: Replay only primary calls that both match the frozen expected call and pass native wire/schema validation.
method_change: System call-format instruction corrected from upstream evidence; additional wire/schema validation reported separately. Questions, schemas, model weights, CPU profile, greedy decoder, EOS and 32-token cap stay fixed.
success_interpretation: At least one correct, independently replayed call shows this interface can produce a valid call on opened cases. It grants no A1 or admission credit.
